title_en: [Green Bio Innovation Convergence University Project Group] Courses Offered in the 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
summary: The Green Bio Innovation Convergence University Project Group announces the shared courses it will offer in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year, with course registration from 7 August to 11 August 2026 via sugang.snu.ac.kr. Interested undergraduate students are asked to refer to the attached files.
applies_to: Undergraduate students who are interested in the shared courses.
steps: Review the attached poster and leaflet for the list of courses offered. (The attachments were not read; their content is not included here.)
Register for courses during the registration period (Friday 7 August to Tuesday 11 August 2026) through the course registration website, sugang.snu.ac.kr.
If you need printed promotional leaflets, request them; they are distributed at any time.
For further information, visit https://cossgb.snu.ac.kr/ or contact the person in charge listed in the original notice.
translation:
Title: [Green Bio Innovation Convergence University Project Group] Promotion of Courses Offered in the 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year
Posted: 27 July 2026

We are pleased to announce the shared courses developed and operated by the [Green Bio Innovation Convergence University Project Group] [그린바이오 혁신융합대학사업단]. Interested undergraduate students are asked to refer to the attached files.

1. Course registration period: Friday 7 August 2026 to Tuesday 11 August 2026

2. Course registration method: sugang.snu.ac.kr

3. Courses offered: (Shared) Agricultural Robotics Engineering [(공유)농업로봇공학] and 22 other courses

4. Requests for printed promotional leaflets: distributed at any time

5. Further information and enquiries: https://cossgb.snu.ac.kr/ — the contact person's name, email address and phone number are given in the original notice.

Attachment 1. Green Bio 2026 2nd Semester Course Guide Poster
Attachment 2. Green Bio 2026 2nd Semester Course Guide Leaflet

Attached files (2):
1. 그린바이오 2026-2학기 개설 교과목 안내 포스터.pdf (Green Bio 2026 2nd Semester Course Guide Poster, 467 KB)
2. 그린바이오 2026-2학기 개설교과목 안내 리플렛.pdf (Green Bio 2026 2nd Semester Course Guide Leaflet, 936 KB)

Note: The attached files were not read, so the full list of courses and any other details they contain are not included in this translation.
